items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Touring Europe. And that’s where… dressed like that, but [inaudible], “Hey, this guy can play,” you know, that sort of thing, before I came to the States. And then, when I just had my permits but I didn’t have the union permit. I had to be six months of a resident, proved residence in New York to be able to work. And Billy was playing the piano at the Hickory House. There was a piano. [Marian McPartland?], [Bac Bachman?] played there, also. And I was, I had a job for a couple of months waiting for me card at…
